messages: Certain versions of this framework are accepted on AMO. However, as the framework does not use a release versioning scheme, and new versions may not be used in AMO add-ons prior to approval, we can not guarantee the acceptance of any particular build using this framework. Please contact the BestToolbars team for information on obtaining an acceptable version.
besttoolbars.name: BestToolbars

messages: The Conduit framework has many issues which prevent its acceptance on AMO. There are currently no plans to allow its use in the future.
conduit.name: Conduit

messages: The Crossrider framework has so far failed to pass review by the AMO team, and may not currently be used for add-ons uploaded to AMO pending updates. Please contact the Crossrider team if you have further questions regarding timelines.
crossrider.name: Crossrider
